snippet.title: Sans & Papyrus - Salsa Lesson - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
made in like 9 months
not idutshane two sorry guys
-------------------------------------------------------------
Download Link: https://gamejolt.com/games/watch_learn_how_to_shoot_gangsta_style_video/990980

CREDITS:
CODING
Mehigh - main coder
TraXsus - coding assistance
Short Monqey - optimized most of the code

ARTISTS
TraXsus - main artist
dELTA - main artist
Malk - made abominations
Shiloh - helped with small tib bits
Mehigh - gore

MUSICIANS
DA - made the teralazing cover (https://soundcloud.com/radioaman-dokan/teralizing-to-f-r)
Malk - main musician
BenLabNo - main musician
sarc - trailer music

WRITERS
Adafi - helped with writing cutscenes
Mehigh - gore in here aswell
Shiloh - helped with writing bits

SPECIAL THANKS
SegaSonic101 - provided menu ambience
Stretch - helped with overworld npc design
King Von (R.I.P)
Tyrop - model seen in trailer, helped with trailer
Bon - provided their portrait cover for an ending

AU CREDITS

UNDERSWAP - popcornprince
